newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firm awards contracts to Siemens, Schneider.
newsitem.headline: Manila firm awards contracts to Siemens, Schneider.

text.p: The Philippines National Power Corporation said on Tuesday it awarded contracts worth a total of four billion pesos to Siemens AG and Groupe Schneider of France to build power sub-stations.

In a statement, Napocor said Siemens bagged a 2.1 billion peso contract for the delivery of substation equipment and materials for the Labrador and San Manuel substations, part of a transmission project in the northern island of Luzon.
Groupe Schneider was awarded a 1.9 billion peso contract for the expansion of an existing substation, also part of the Northwestern Luzon Transmission and Substation Project.
The transmission project will help ferry electricity from two Napocor coal power plants, the 600-megawatt Masinloc project and the 1,000-mw Sual in northern Luzon.
Napocor said the Asian Development Bank and the Japan Eximbank are providing financing for the Northwestern Luzon project.
